risk: Changing or externally governing reducer dispatch tags could break guarded local queue hydration or transport controls. These tags do not authorize media access.
justification: Individually reviewed all nine queue reducer tags: restore,replace,enqueue,select,remove,move,clear,shuffle,repeat. The added restore action installs a previously validated matching-owner snapshot through internal guarded hydration; the remaining eight are unchanged client queue operations. These implementation dispatch discriminants are not selectable business catalog values or a privilege registry.
